title: Microcytic anemia with low ferritin and high TIBC

patient_context.chief_complaint: Explain which anemia mechanism is best supported by the supplied laboratory pattern.
patient_context.history: No inflammatory disorder is supplied. The benchmark does not specify the cause of any iron deficiency.

interaction.prompt: Rank iron deficiency anemia versus anemia of inflammation using the supplied pattern. State what is supported and what remains unknown about etiology.

must_include: Rank iron deficiency anemia as the best-supported mechanism because the pattern combines microcytosis, low ferritin, high TIBC and low transferrin saturation.
Use the multi-marker pattern rather than one isolated value.
State that the case does not identify the cause of the iron deficiency.
must_not_claim: Do not infer a specific bleeding source or dietary cause.
Do not claim that every microcytic anemia is iron deficiency.
acceptable_actions: Return IDA as top-ranked explanation with a concise evidence chain.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: High confidence in the mechanism pattern; cause remains unresolved.

forbidden_claims: a specific bleeding source is proven
expected_reasoning_path: low ferritin + high TIBC + low TSAT

critical_errors: Invents a causal diagnosis not present in the case.
Ranks anemia of inflammation above IDA while ignoring the iron-study pattern without justification.
